reason.user-edited-since-prose: You changed this after the cited entry.
reason.later-turn: A later entry already changed this.
reason.turns-full-id: The write cited an entry by its full id instead of the short reference it was shown.
reason.not-a-turn: The write cited something that isn't an entry.
reason.turn-not-shown: The write cited an entry the task wasn't shown.
reason.unread: The write came before the row was read.
reason.id-shape: The write named its rows the wrong way.
reason.id-full: The write named a row by its full id instead of the short reference it was shown.
reason.id-unknown: The write named a row it wasn't shown.
reason.id-wrong-kind: The write named the wrong kind of row.
reason.turn-in-text: The text named an entry by its id.
reason.keyword-in-both: A keyword was both added and removed.
reason.nothing-sent: The write held nothing to change.
reason.parent-and-top: The place was both placed inside another and marked top level.
reason.title-taken: Another lore row has this title.
reason.body-over-limit: The body is over the length limit.
reason.body-growth: The body grew more than a close may add.
reason.over-soft-cap: The list is over its cap.
reason.not-a-place-or-item: The row isn't a place or an item.
reason.not-unplaced: Only an unplaced place can be marked top level.
reason.parent-not-a-place: The parent isn't a live place.
reason.parent-cycle: The place would sit inside itself.
reason.parent-chain-broken: The place's chain of parents is broken.
reason.story-inside: The move would hide the story's place.
reason.keyword-pairs-flag: That keyword ties the row to a flag you haven't settled.
reason.not-active: Only an active row can retire.
reason.in-scene-later: A later entry still has this character in the scene.
reason.partner-is-self: A row can't be a duplicate of itself.
reason.partner-not-of-kind: The two rows are different kinds.
reason.already-flagged: Both rows already hold other flags.
reason.flag-held-by-partner: The other row already holds a flag for this pair.
reason.pair-resolved: You already kept these two rows apart.
reason.merge-absorb-empty: The merge named no thread to fold in.
reason.merge-keep-absorbed: The kept thread was also listed to fold in.
reason.merge-repeated: The merge named a thread twice.
reason.merge-active-into-inactive: An active thread can fold only into another active one.
reason.merge-mode-into-other: A thread you set to always or disabled can fold only into one with the same setting.
reason.merge-close-wrote: This close already wrote a thread the merge would fold away.
reason.merge-no-keep: No thread to keep fits the merge.
reason.merge-close-wrote-no-keep: This close already wrote these threads, and no thread to keep fits the merge.

stopped.cut-off: a reply was cut off or filtered twice

review.noToolCalls: No task called a tool, so this close wrote only the chapter itself. The model may not support tool calling.
